entries.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
entries.snippet: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.

entries.title: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

entries.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
entries.snippet: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

entries.title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
entries.snippet: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.

entries.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
entries.snippet: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

entries.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
entries.snippet: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".

entries.title: Paraguay's former president charged after bank collapse
entries.snippet: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.

entries.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
entries.snippet: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

entries.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.

entries.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
entries.snippet: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

entries.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
entries.snippet: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.

entries.title: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
entries.snippet: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.

entries.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
entries.snippet: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

entries.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
entries.snippet: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

entries.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
entries.snippet: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

entries.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
entries.snippet: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

entries.title: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded
entries.snippet: Video authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment gunshots rang out in Krakow's main market square.

entries.title: Gaza wedding festival sees 250 couples married at the same time
entries.snippet: A mass wedding for Palestinian brides and grooms has taken place in the rubble-strewn streets of Gaza.

entries.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
entries.snippet: The car company's CEO Elon Musk has said production will halt in Texas, to focus on the firm's self-driving Cybercabs.

entries.title: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
entries.snippet: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.

entries.title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
entries.snippet: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.

entries.title: Climate change is altering the colors we see in the world: an illustrated journey
entries.snippet: From Arctic landscapes to insect bodies, climate change is shifting the familiar colors of nature.

entries.title: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
entries.snippet: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

entries.title: How Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave for Democrats
entries.snippet: Republicans made gains with young voters in 2024, but in this year's midterms Americans under 30 issued a strong rebuke of President Trump and his party, voting decisively for Democrats instead.

entries.title: UFC's Dana White says he will meet with Trump Monday over offer to be White House press secretary
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White.

entries.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
entries.snippet: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.

entries.title: The surprising and often forgotten history of economic populism in Texas
entries.snippet: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Austin-based political commentator David Griscom. He authored a book titled The Myth of Red Texas which tells the story of economic populism in Texas.

entries.title: Oklahoma tribes say proposed legal changes put ancestral lands in Ohio at risk
entries.snippet: The Trump administration has proposed changes to the National Historic Preservation Act that could endanger historic sites significant to tribal nations across the country. Oklahoma tribes say that puts ancestral lands in Ohio at risk.

entries.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
entries.snippet: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.

entries.title: Polish gunman who killed 6 people in Krakow has 'ultranationalistic' views, authorities say
entries.snippet: A gunman targeted random people as he drove into Krakow's Main Square, a major tourist spot. Police shot and wounded the gunman during a gunfight.

entries.title: What is Diwali, the Festival of Lights, and how is it celebrated?
entries.snippet: The festival follows the Hindu lunar calendar, typically falling in late October or early November. This year, Diwali falls on Nov. 8.

entries.title: Sen. Chris Murphy's stroke at 53 highlights a trend: Strokes among younger adults have risen
entries.snippet: Researchers found that the stroke incidence rate among adults from 1993-94 nearly doubled in 2020, jumping from 33.90 cases per 100,000 people to 62.18 cases.

entries.title: Trump says he's asked UFC's Dana White to be his press secretary
entries.snippet: Trump's social media post about the offer came as his White House is in a period of major transition and struggling with his party's deep losses in Tuesday's midterm elections.

entries.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate Eisenkot to form a government, in setback for Netanyahu
entries.snippet: Neither Eisenkot nor Netanyahu won a clear majority in the vote. But in marathon discussions with the president this week, representatives from most of Israel's main parties recommended Eisenkot be tasked with assembling a new government.

entries.title: Melania Trump and LSU announce a scholarship program for students who were in foster care
entries.snippet: Trump and LSU secured more than $7 million in private donations to create an endowment fund for the scholarships, the White House said.

entries.title: Judge wants former U.S. attorney to investigate whether the government misled her in Trump golf case
entries.snippet: The administration plans to close the East Potomac Golf Course and park on Nov. 15 with the intention of constructing a "World Class, championship-level golf course that is capable of hosting major events."

entries.title: With an ode to mate, Pope Leo urges faithful in Uruguay to build bridges of fraternity and faith
entries.snippet: More than 30,000 people — many from Uruguay but also from neighboring Argentina and Brazil — had registered in advance to attend the service. The Vatican said Saturday that another 10,000 had attended, despite the morning rain.

entries.title: Scott Colom and Black Mississippians stand on the cusp of Senate history as vote count stretches on
entries.snippet: The state is still tallying ballots that could make Colom the first Black senator from this Deep South state since post-Civil War Reconstruction.

entries.title: In his words: Stephen Miller is an immigration hardliner and a bombastic critic of Democrats
entries.snippet: An outspoken defender of President Donald Trump's most far-reaching goals to remake government going back to his 2016 run for president, Miller is known for his harsh language and unapologetic bombast.

entries.title: Gunman opens fire in Polish city of Krakow, killing 6 people and wounding 16
entries.snippet: The suspect, a 25-year-old Polish citizen, opened fire with an automatic weapon in the city's Main Square. He was fascinated with far-right ideologies and held "very radical views," Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said at a news conference.

entries.title: Paraguay's ousted president charged with crimes linked to collapse of major bank
entries.snippet: Paraguayan prosecutors on Friday ordered the arrest of Peña and former Central Bank chief Carlos Carvallo as part of a criminal investigation into alleged breach of trust and other offenses tied to the collapse of Ueno Bank.

entries.title: Justice Department drops bid to force California to set aside disputed ballots
entries.snippet: The move comes days after Republicans' significant losses in the midterm elections and about a week before a scheduled hearing where a special master was slated to evaluate the accuracy of the list of alleged noncitizens.

entries.title: What Trump picking Stephen Miller for chief of staff signals about his agenda
entries.snippet: Trump has replaced White House chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller, the hardline architect of his immigration agenda, after a crushing midterm defeat. Immigration, once a political strength for Trump, became a liability after two years of mass detentions, deportations

entries.title: News Wrap: Judge blocks construction of Trump's triumphal arch for now

entries.title: What to know about a better-than-expected jobs report amid AI bubble concerns
entries.snippet: Employers added 165,000 new jobs in October, according to a new government report. Job gains for August and September were revised upward as well, by a combined 84,000 jobs. That makes the last three months of the job market look better than expected, but it comes as questions gr

entries.title: Sen.-elect Hamilton reflects on why Kansas voters chose a Democrat for U.S. Senate
entries.snippet: Democrats' midterm wins have reached red states across the country, including Kansas, which has not sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 1932. That will soon change after Rev. Adam Hamilton, who leads the largest United Methodist church in the country, defeated Republican inc

entries.title: Georgia Gov.-elect Bottoms reflects on historic victory and the path forward for Democrats
entries.snippet: Georgia voters made history this week, electing Keisha Lance Bottoms as the state's first Democratic senator in more than two decades and the first-ever Black woman governor in the country. The former Atlanta mayor campaigned on lowering costs, expanding healthcare access and pus

entries.title: Former Sen. Flake, outspoken Trump critic, on the GOP reckoning post-midterms
entries.snippet: As Democrats celebrate their historic gains, Republicans are beginning to take stock of major upsets and what comes next for their party. Amna Nawaz speaks with former Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake, one of the most outspoken Republican critics of Trump during his first administration a

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump's White House shakeup and fallout from the midterms
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Geoff Bennett to discuss the week in politics, including Trump shaking up his White House leadership, deep divisions in the Republican Party and how Democrats are preparing to take control of Congress.

entries.title: Remembering Jay Rockefeller's life and legacy of public service
entries.snippet: Jay Rockefeller, former West Virginia governor and longtime U.S. senator, has died at age 89. Born into one of America's wealthiest and most prominent families, Rockefeller forged his own path in politics and became a leading voice on healthcare, education and the needs of workin

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: 'Never Again!': Holocaust remembrance under pressure
entries.snippet: Only a few Holocaust survivors remain who can share their stories firsthand. Meanwhile, voices calling for an end to what they describe as a "cult of guilt" are growing louder. How can Holocaust remembrance survive?

entries.title: Poland begins two days of mourning over Krakow shooting
entries.snippet: Polish authorities have opened a terror probe after the shooting on Krakow's Main Square. Police confirmed that the bodies found at the suspect's home were those of his parents and sister.

entries.title: Germany news: Friedrich Merz set to confirm presidential nominee
entries.snippet: The executive committee of the German chancellor's CDU party is expected to finalize its nomination for the country's president. DW has more.

entries.title: India: Delhi chokes on most polluted Diwali eve in 10 years
entries.snippet: Delhi was ranked as the world's most polluted major city on the eve of Diwali. Delhi's air pollution is expected to get worse in the coming days. DW has more.

entries.title: As COP31 Antalya kicks off, can world move beyond big promises?
entries.snippet: Droughts, floods and extreme heat are upping the pressure on delegates at the UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey. Can countries move beyond pledges to concrete action?

entries.title: Poland: Gunman kills 6 in Krakow main square, police say
entries.snippet: A suspect who fired from a car killed at least six people, including a British tourist, in Krakow's main market square. Officials said the man was fascinated with "radical" and "far-right" ideologies.

entries.title: Ebola: Why is there still no vaccine?
entries.snippet: Ebola has been known about for decades, but there is still no vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the virus causing the current outbreak. New research raises hopes of protection against the various types of Ebola.

entries.title: Israeli president tasks Gadi Eisenkot with forming government
entries.snippet: President Isaac Herzog has picked former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot, leader of an anti-Netanyahu alliance, to take the first shot at trying to form a government. Tricky coalition talks are expected.

entries.title: Trump offers White House press secretary role to Dana White
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump has offered the White House press secretary job to Dana White, the chief executive of the Ultimate Fighting Championship. White has neither formally accepted nor turned down the invitation.

entries.title: France sees new round of Yellow Vest, student protests
entries.snippet: Although fewer protesters turned out in comparison with previous weeks, several cities saw clashes between police and demonstrators.

entries.title: Armenia's selective prosecution: A threat to EU relations?
entries.snippet: While Brussels has refrained from harsh criticism, Armenian civil society has warned of selective justice against opposition figures. Could the EU's pragmatic stance risk repeating past mistakes?

entries.title: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections
entries.snippet: Near-final results show South Africa's once dominant ANC will see its lowest-ever vote percentage. The party is taking the blame for shoddy municipal services, including water and electricity shortages.

entries.title: More than 40,000 gather as Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass in Uruguay
entries.snippet: Leo celebrated the first Mass of his South America tour less than a month after undergoing cancer surgery. He is seeking to raise interest in the Catholic Church in Uruguay, South America's most secular country.

entries.title: Journalism and AI: Who owns the news?
entries.snippet: Publishers say AI chatbots are using their reporting to answer readers' questions while sending back less traffic and less money. Should the companies that build these tools pay for the journalism they rely on?

entries.title: Son of Iran's shah receives 'Freedom Prize' in Frankfurt
entries.snippet: 18,000 people gathered in Frankfurt to show support for Reza Pahlavi, the son of the Iranian monarch ousted in 1979. Factions in the opposition have accused him of not distancing himself from his father's rule.

entries.title: After victory in the midterms, what next for US Democrats?
entries.snippet: Donald Trump's Republican party has lost its majority in both chambers of the US Congress. But the president still has a lot of power — and the Democrats have yet to agree on how best to use theirs.

entries.title: Italy's Meloni blames pro-Russian hackers for cyberattack on minister
entries.snippet: Antonio Tajani has said hackers published personal data stolen from him as Giorgia Meloni blamed pro-Russia criminals for the incident. The news follows a string of bomb threats that have grounded flights across the EU.

entries.title: Yemen: 33 killed in strike near Sanaa, Houthis say
entries.snippet: The Iran-backed Houthi rebel group accused Saudi Arabia of hitting several homes in the village of al-Shariya near the Yemeni capital.

entries.title: New Zealand election too close to call with over 95% of votes counted
entries.snippet: Initial results in New Zealand show the two main parties neck-and-neck with fewer than 4,000 votes separating them. Official results aren't expected until later this month once special votes have been counted.
